entities.summary: Eduardo Marquina Angulo was a Spanish playwright and poet associated with the Catalan Modernist school. His En Flandes se ha puesto el Sol was awarded the Royal Spanish Academy's award for historical drama. He also wrote lyrics for the Spanish anthem Marcha Real, used during the reign of Alfonso XIII. Eduardo Marquina was a poets & playwrights from Barcelona (1879-01-21, Barcelona–1946-11-21). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
